_note: THE DEPOSIT'S STATE, IN WORDS — driven by BOTH halves so they cannot drift.
There are two invoices for one booking: the guest's HTML page (invoice.php,
invoice_deposit_status) and the owner's jsPDF download (app.js,
depositInvoiceStatus). They used to disagree — the PDF said a kept deposit was
'Retained after checkout for damage or loss' while the emailed invoice said the
same £75 'is returned in full after checkout', because the HTML half had one
static sentence for every state. Same shape as pricing-fixtures.json: add a case
settled is already in the house DD/MM/YYYY form; both halves only ever print it.

cases.want: Paid — refunded in full after your stay, provided there is no damage.

refunded, but the ledger is ahead of the status column — same answer
